_why: The only source of LoRA training defaults. `pnpm lora train` reads it and refuses a run below `final.minSteps` / `final.minEpochs` unless given --under-budget "<reason>"; train-oracle.ps1 refuses fewer than 40 epochs on its own. Change a number only by naming a newer sweep that beats the reference on the same 32-frame check (.ai/lora-training.md, the step budget row).

reference.name: ari_adopt_v4
reference.proof: 2026-09-24, same 32-frame check: ari_adopt_v4 at 40 epochs 3/16 dressed frames wrong; the same file at epoch 24 (~11,900 steps) 7/16; ari_gen_v5 at 30 epochs (12,270 steps) 6/16. The ari_gen line (v1-v5) trained at 62 % of this budget and shuffled garment colours in all five.
